create.name: Joseph Goldstein
create.bio:
Joseph Goldstein is one of the first Americans to teach vipassana, or insight meditation. A philosophy graduate from New York, he met Buddhism while serving with the Peace Corps in Thailand in the mid-1960s and then spent the best part of seven years in India, practising under Anagarika Munindra in Bodh Gaya and later with S.N. Goenka, Dipa Ma and the Burmese master Sayadaw U Pandita. Tibetan teachers, among them Tulku Urgyen and Nyoshul Khen Rinpoche, shaped his practice too. He began leading retreats in 1974, and a year later he set up the Insight Meditation Society in Barre, Massachusetts, together with Sharon Salzberg and Jack Kornfield; he went on to help start the Barre Center for Buddhist Studies and the Forest Refuge for long personal retreats.

His teaching is clear, patient and practical, built on mindfulness of body and mind as laid out in the Satipatthana Sutta, with lovingkindness alongside. He still guides residential and online retreats at IMS and hosts the Insight Hour podcast. His books include The Experience of Insight, Insight Meditation, One Dharma, A Heart Full of Peace and Mindfulness: A Practical Guide to Awakening, and he co-wrote Seeking the Heart of Wisdom with Jack Kornfield.

books.title: Mindfulness: A Practical Guide to Awakening
books.author: Joseph Goldstein
books.description: A large, chapter-by-chapter commentary on the Satipatthana Sutta, the Buddha's discourse on the four foundations of mindfulness. It grew out of a long series of talks and moves between the text and practical advice for sitting and daily life.

books.title: The Experience of Insight: A Simple and Direct Guide to Buddhist Meditation
books.author: Joseph Goldstein
books.description: His first book, drawn from talks given on a month-long retreat in the 1970s. It is arranged as thirty days of themes, from posture and walking practice to the deeper stages of insight.

books.title: Insight Meditation: The Practice of Freedom
books.author: Joseph Goldstein
books.description: Short pieces on the core of vipassana practice and how it carries into ordinary life, with questions and answers from students. A readable starting point for newer meditators.

books.title: One Dharma: The Emerging Western Buddhism
books.author: Joseph Goldstein
books.description: Looks at how the Theravada, Tibetan and Zen schools meet in the West and what they share. He draws on his own decades of practice in more than one tradition.

books.title: A Heart Full of Peace
books.author: Joseph Goldstein
books.description: A small book on compassion, lovingkindness and mindfulness as ways of living with others. Brief chapters suit reading one at a time.

books.title: The Path of Insight Meditation
books.author: Joseph Goldstein, Jack Kornfield
books.description: A pocket-sized selection from the authors' longer guide, with short readings on meditation and living mindfully.

courses.title: Experience of Insight: A 30-Day Practice of Buddhist Wisdom Teachings 2027
courses.description: An IMS Online month that follows his book The Experience of Insight, one theme a day. He opens it with a live talk and questions on 30 December, after which three other IMS teachers (Rachel Lewis, Yong Oh and Tuere Sala) lead a daily guided sitting drawn from the book.

free_resources.title: Insight Hour with Joseph Goldstein (podcast)
free_resources.description: His long-running podcast on the Be Here Now Network: retreat talks and conversations, including a long series working through the Satipatthana Sutta.

free_resources.title: Joseph Goldstein's talks on Dharma Seed
free_resources.description: A large free archive of his recorded talks and guided meditations from IMS and other retreat centres, going back decades.
